package.description: This is the official CLI for the IPinfo.io IP address API.

en-US.description: This is the official CLI for the IPinfo.io IP address API.
en-US.longDescription:
The official IPinfo CLI lets you look up IP details (geolocation, ASN, company,
privacy, abuse, hosted domains, and more) one-by-one or in bulk. It also bundles
a suite of IP/CIDR/range tooling (grepip, prips, cidr2range, matchip, mmdb, …).
en-US.name: ipinfo
